description: This file defines the 'Each' class in the GuzzleHttp\Promise namespace, providing static methods for handling promise-based iteration over collections of promises or values, with support for limits and error handling.

classes.name: Each
classes.description: A final class providing static methods to work with collections of promises and values, applying callbacks on fulfillment or rejection, and managing concurrency limits.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a promise that resolves after iterating over the provided iterable, executing optional callbacks on fulfilled and rejected promises.

methods.name: ofLimit
methods.description: Creates a promise that processes the iterable with a specified concurrency limit, applying callbacks accordingly.

methods.name: ofLimitAll
methods.description: Processes the iterable with a concurrency limit, rejecting the aggregate promise if any promise is rejected.
